content:
<#if execution.status == "FAILED"> Email Notification

Crawler Execution Failed for ${assembly.name}

Datasource Name: ${assembly.name}

Tenant: ${assembly.tenantId}

Status: ${execution.status} ❌

Crawling Type: ${execution.crawlingType} ❌

<#if execution.selectedAssets?has_content>

Selected Assets: ${execution.selectedAssets?join(", ")}

Started At: ${acceldata_dateFormat(execution.createdAt)}

Finished At: ${acceldata_dateFormat(execution.updatedAt)}

Visit Datasource Page link.

Failure Reason:

${execution.errorMessage}
<#elseif execution.status == "COMPLETED"> Email Notification

Successful Crawler Execution for Datasource: ${assembly.name}

Datasource Name: ${assembly.name}

Tenant: ${assembly.tenantId}

Status: ${execution.status} ✅

Crawling Type: ${execution.crawlingType}

<#if execution.selectedAssets?has_content>

Selected Assets: ${execution.selectedAssets?join(", ")}

Started At: ${acceldata_dateFormat(execution.createdAt)}

Finished At: ${acceldata_dateFormat(execution.updatedAt)}

Visit Datasource Page link.

Datasource Summary

<#if assetCounters?has_content> <#list assetCounters as asset>
Asset Type Count
${asset.type} ${asset.count}
subject:
<#if execution.status == "FAILED">
	${tenant}: Failed Crawler Execution For Datasource: ${assembly.name} - tenant: ${assembly.tenantId}
<#elseif execution.status == "COMPLETED">
	${tenant}: Successful Crawler Execution For Datasource: ${assembly.name} - tenant: ${assembly.tenantId}
</#if>
